label: Diagram 16.1
caption: Diagram 16.1 Fire resisting construction for smoke outlet shafts
description: The drawing is a cross-section in two parts, with a note at top left reading 'See paras 16.1 and 16.13' and a title band at the bottom reading 'Diagram 16.1 Fire resisting construction for smoke outlet shafts'. At top right a green square is keyed to 'Fire resisting construction of floor see Section 5 and/or Section 7', with the line 'Fire resisting construction achieving the same rating as the floor of the ground storey' beneath it. The left part shows an 'External wall' as a vertical line above a horizontal 'Ground floor' band filled green; below is a grey mass labelled 'Basement'. A shaft, outlined in green, runs diagonally up from the ground floor to the external wall, marked 'Stallboard outlet with grill or removable cover'. The right part is similar, with 'External wall', a green 'Ground floor' band and a grey 'Basement'; here a horizontal dashed line at the level of the ground floor band, running into the grey mass, is marked 'Basement outlet with break-out or openable cover'.
